Kit summary

Mana ImpactBasic
Deals 260% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 30% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn. When Inna has activated Lv.2 [Overflowing Mana], this [Stun] cannot be removed.
Mana ShieldActiveExclusive Lv.1
Grants all allies a [Shield] by 30% of Inna's Max HP for 2 turns, the effect of which is increased to 45% for targets from Nameless Brotherhood, Doom Legion, and Eternal Sect.
Mana Bladeshield Lv.1When casting Mana Shield at Lv.2 [Overflowing Mana], Inna grants [Consolidation II] for all allies for 2 turns; if [Overflowing Mana] has not reached Lv.2, Inna grants [Consolidation I] for all allies for 2 turns.
Instinct ManaPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Gains 15 layers of [Mana Residual] at the beginning of the battle, gains 5 layers for every 1 Nameless Brotherhood, Doom Legion, or Eternal Sect ally, and gains 2 layers for every 1 ally from other Factions. [Mana Residual] will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition. Meanwhile, when there are 20/25/30 layers of [Mana Residual], Inna activates Lv.1/Lv.2/Lv.3 [Overflowing Mana]: Lv.1 [Overflowing Mana] Additionally increases self DEF by 50%; Lv.2 [Overflowing Mana]: Additionally increases self Shield Effect by 30%; Lv.3 [Overflowing Mana]: Additionally increases self Effect Hit by 100%.
Mana Bladeshield Lv.2Increases the layers of [Mana Residual] granted by every 1 Nameless Brotherhood, Doom Legion, or Eternal Sect ally to 8; when there are 40 layers of [Mana Residual], Inna additionally activates Lv.4 [Overflowing Mana]: Lv.4 [Overflowing Mana]: At the beginning of each wave and at the end of each turn, grants self 1 layer of [Mana Protection], up to 1 layer, which is immune to all DMG dealt and becomes invalid after taking Direct ATK 1 time.
Mana ErosionActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 100% DEF DMG each to all enemies. Meanwhile, the 2nd and the 3rd stage have a 50% chance to increase the CD of the targets' all skills by 1 turn (caps at the Max CD). The CD of this skill will not be increased or reduced by any effects.
Mana Bladeshield Lv.3Each time Mana Erosion successfully increases the targets' skill CD, there is an 80% chance to inflict [Feebleness II] for 2 turns.
